```plato

//==
// # Simplices and polyhedral solids
//
// The flat-faced solids: the tetrahedron (the 3D simplex), the triangular prism
// swept by a vector, and the convex region carved out by a set of bounding planes. A
// solid denotes the filled region including its boundary surface.

// The solid simplex spanned by four vertices. Signed volume is positive when
// D lies on the positive side of triangle A, B, C.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrahedron)
type Tetrahedron
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, IPointSet3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, IDeformable3D
{
    A: Point3D;
    B: Point3D;
    C: Point3D;
    D: Point3D;
}

// A triangular prism: the Base triangle swept by Offset. Offset need not be
// perpendicular to the base (an oblique wedge).
// NOT Deformable3D: the sweep VECTOR has no principled image under a point
// mapping (see Prism3D in `polygons.types.plato`).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wedge_(geometry))
type Wedge
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D
{
    Base: Triangle3D;
    Offset: Vector3D;
}

// The intersection of the half-spaces behind each plane (normals point
// outward): a convex region. Bounded only when the planes enclose a finite
// volume; a camera frustum is the canonical instance.
// NOT Deformable3D: the region is carved by PLANES, not spanned by points; the
// image of a plane under an arbitrary mapping is not a plane.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convex_polytope)
type ConvexVolume
    implements IGeometry3D, IConvexShape, IConnected, IContainsPoint3D
{
    Planes: Array<Plane>;
}

//==
// # Spheres and ellipsoids
//
// The radially symmetric solids (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid_geometry): the
// ball, the hollow region between two concentric spheres, the cap cut from a ball by
// a plane, and the ellipsoid that generalizes all three. A solid type denotes the
// filled region INCLUDING its boundary surface; axes are unit directions.

// The ball of all points within Radius of Center; its boundary is the sphere
// proper. Radius is non-negative. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sphere)
type Sphere
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, IContainsPoint3D, INearestPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Radius: Number;
}

// The hollow region between two concentric spheres.
// Invariant: 0 <= InnerRadius <= OuterRadius.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_shell)
type SphericalShell
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentered3D, IContainsPoint3D
{
    Center: Point3D;
    InnerRadius: Number;
    OuterRadius: Number;
}

// The solid cap cut from a ball: the points of Sphere within PolarAngle of the
// Axis direction as seen from the center, closed by the cutting plane.
// PolarAngle is in (0, pi]; pi gives the whole ball.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_cap)
type SphericalCap
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D
{
    Sphere: Sphere;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    PolarAngle: Angle;
}

// A solid ellipsoid with semi-axis lengths SemiAxes along its local X, Y, and Z,
// oriented by Orientation about Center. A sphere when all semi-axes are equal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipsoid)
type Ellipsoid
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, ISupport3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    SemiAxes: Number3;
    Orientation: Quaternion;
}

//==
// # Tori
//
// The ring solid swept by a disk around a circle. A solid denotes the filled region
// including its boundary surface; the axis is a unit direction.

// A solid torus: all points within MinorRadius of the circle of MajorRadius
// about Center in the plane perpendicular to Axis. Self-intersecting when
// MinorRadius exceeds MajorRadius. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus)
type Torus
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D, IParametricSurface
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    MajorRadius: Number;
    MinorRadius: Number;
}
```
